mandatory_outcomes.observable_outcome: No draft, review, publish, query-console, or AI-generation controls in the explorer.
Search finds preferred labels, aliases, IDs, and relevant definition text.
A user can read both endpoints, the relationship label, and its direction.
The map supports selection, pan, zoom, focus, and bounded expansion.
Process pages expose only source-supported descriptions and ordering.
Back/Forward and view switching retain the selected identity and route state.
All substantive graph information and navigation have a text alternative.
Reader and graph information trace to the selected canonical ontology.
Multiple relations, qualifiers, lifecycle, and fact classifications are not silently merged.
Definitions and relations link to source references and freshness information.
Initial browsing neither searches nor changes the memory subsystem.
Browser requests cannot draft, publish, run a skill, mutate a Task, or change profiles.
Loopback, session, origin, source-allowlist, and safe-rendering protections remain effective.
The same code works with the root, neutral template, and another explicitly selected project.
Large graphs remain navigable through limits, paging, and visible incompleteness.

acceptance_scenarios.scenario: Launch the human interface. Only reading/exploration destinations appear; no authoring modules or controls load.
Search a preferred label, alias, exact ID, and words in a definition. Matching is deterministic and relevant.
Two entries share a label/alias. Both appear with distinctions; neither is silently selected.
Apply category/lifecycle filters to a multi-page result set. Filtering happens before pagination; valid later matches remain reachable.
Search returns more matches than one page permits. Continuation is stable, with no duplicate or skipped identities within the same snapshot.
A result is omitted by a byte/time/traversal bound. The UI reports incomplete coverage rather than “nothing exists.”
Read an entry with definition, aliases, scope note, and examples. Present fields faithfully; omit absent sections without inventing content.
Open a deprecated entry by exact ID. Show its status and recorded replacement without silently rewriting history.
A draft or inferred record is available under an explicit permitted filter. Its status remains distinct from approved asserted knowledge.
Select a graph node. Details change, but the camera and graph focus do not unexpectedly move.
Choose Focus here. The neighborhood changes deliberately, and Back restores the prior useful state.
Expand a high-degree node. Limits remain enforced and omitted connections are clearly disclosed.
Two predicates connect the same endpoints. Both canonical relationship IDs and their meanings remain inspectable.
Traverse an incoming relationship. Arrow and sentence retain the canonical subject–predicate–object direction.
Render self-loops, cycles, and qualified relationships. No infinite expansion or semantic merging occurs.
Switch between map and list. Selection, filters, returned scope, and warnings agree.
Open a supported process. Purpose, roles, inputs/outputs, and ordering appear only where supported by the selected source.
A process has no recorded step order. Show the gap; do not infer a sequence from graph layout or unrelated relations.
Open a definition's or relationship's source. Show the authorized locator/excerpt and evidence status for the correct identity.
The source bytes change after the entry loads. Do not present the new bytes as the originally recorded evidence without a warning/version distinction.
Canonical inputs change during navigation or publication. Reject mixed-version continuations; refresh the display coherently.
A slow response for entry A arrives after selecting B. B remains the current entry.
Session expires or service stops. Preserve readable context and desired route; explain reconnection without making unauthorized startup claims.
Submit direct browser requests to old write or execution endpoints. They fail; no protected artifacts change.
Use invalid Host/Origin/CSRF/session values or another service's credentials. Requests fail without leaking project data.
Attempt encoded traversal, absolute-path access, symlink escape, or an unselected source reference. Access is denied.
Labels/source text contain HTML, script-like text, or malicious links. They display safely and do not execute.
Load the production bundle under the production CSP with no internet. Reader and graph work without remote assets.
Complete all major reading tasks by keyboard and via the relationship list. No drag, hover, or canvas-only action is required.
Use narrow viewport, browser zoom, reduced motion, and both themes. Text reflows, controls remain operable, and important states remain legible.
Browse the root and neutral template, then a separate namespace fixture. No hard-coded project identity, cache leakage, or source crossover occurs.
Perform all read workflows with missing optional embedding/RDF services. Core reading works; nothing is installed or started implicitly.
Compare protected file hashes/timestamps before and after the read workflow. Ontology, memory, proposals, receipts, and generated products are unchanged.
Disable or fail the graph renderer. Definitions, relationship list, and evidence access still work.
Run existing agent retrieval, publication/recovery, and template contract tests. No unintended behavioral regression occurs.
Measure the representative and stress fixtures. Publish actual timings, memory/limits, and graceful-degradation results rather than assumed performance.

interpretation: Exact source-derived coverage aid; scenarios are future acceptance behavior, not performed verification.
